exercises.name: Count from 1 to 10 using the following nouns

questions.answer: Umuntu umwe, abantu babiri, abantu batatu, abantu bane, abantu batanu, abantu batandatu, abantu barindwi, abantu munani, abantu cyenda, abantu cumi.
Umusozi umwe, imisozi ibiri, imisozi itatu, imisozi ine, imisozi itanu, imisozi itandatu, imisozi irindwi, imisozi munani, imisozi cyenda, imisozi cumi.
Inka imwe, inka ebyiri, inka eshatu, inka enye, inka eshanu, inka esheshatu, inka ndwi, inka munani, inka cyenda, inka cumi.
Ikintu kimwe, ibintu bibiri, ibintu bitatu, ibintu bine, ibintu bitanu, ibintu bitandatu, ibintu birindwi, ibintu munani, ibintu cyenda, ibintu cumi
Urukwavu rumwe, inkwavu ebyiri, inkwavu eshatu, inkwavu enye, inkwavu eshanu, inkwavu esheshatu, inkwavu ndwi, inkwavu munani, inkwavu cyenda, inkwavu cumi
